cases.name: fresh
cases.provenance: cli/build.sh output committed after the CLI change, as chore(bin) commits do
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git add bin
git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'

cases.name: test-and-e2e-change-after-build

cases.name: cli-change-after-build
cases.provenance: a CLI commit with no chore(bin) rebuild after it, the gap each chore(bin) commit such as cde1994 closes by hand
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done
git add bin
git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'
echo '// change' >> cli/main.go
git commit -qam 'fix: cli'

cases.name: missing-target
cases.provenance: a build that wrote three of the four shipped targets
cases.setup:
export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=t GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=t@t GIT_COMMITTER_NAME=t GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL=t@t GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null
git init -q .
git add cli/main.go
git commit -qm 'feat: cli'
stamp=$(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)
for t in darwin-amd64 darwin-arm64 linux-amd64 linux-arm64; do mkdir -p bin/$t; printf 'ELF\0%s\0end' "$stamp" > bin/$t/steer; done

git commit -qm 'chore(bin): rebuild'
git rm -q bin/linux-arm64/steer
